messages:
release-captain: Quick heads-up — changing the canary cadence for this week's train. We need to shorten the canary window and start a docs embargo to prioritize stability for the model/serving changes rolling out Friday 10:00 UTC. Details and action items below. :warning:

deploy-bot: Canary job started for release v4.2.1-canary (pool=dedicated-s1). Monitoring hooks enabled.

ana: acked, will pause feature-flag merges into main until embargo lifted.

jordan: Can you clarify rollback thresholds? If latency > 150ms p50 or error rate > 0.5% do we auto-roll back?

release-captain: Good question. New thresholds for this train: latency p50 > 140ms for two consecutive 5m windows OR 5xx rate > 0.4% triggers automated pause and notify SRE. Full rollback criteria in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rollback (see section "canary-alert-rules").

sasha: For observability: enable the slow-path logs and increase retention for traces for the canary group to 48h. I'll push the monitor tweak now.

mike: Docs side — I'll lock the docs repo for merges at 09:30 UTC Fri. Any critical doc changes file a docs-exception in #eng-docs and ping me. Example exception format: `EXCEPTION: <PR#> <reason> <owner>`

emily: QA will run the new latency/throughput battery against canary v4.2.1 at 08:00 UTC Fri. Tagging @qa leads. We'll post a short results summary in this thread.

jordan: Also flagging dependency rollout: quant-lib v2.3 is in this canary. If quant-lib shows tokenization drift beyond 0.2% on eval set A, we pause. Tests are in CI: `ci/evals/quant-drift.sh`.

release-captain: Exception process recap: to request an exception for the docs embargo, create a PR with label `release/docs-exception` and mention `@release-captain` + `@mike`. Approvals required: eng lead + docs owner. We will only approve security or compliance-critical docs during embargo.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot (t=+12m): p50=86ms, p95=210ms, 5xx=0.03%, token RPS=420. No alerts firing.

sasha: Pushing monitor updates now. ETA 5m.

ana: I've paused non-essential feature flags in staging and prod-ramp pools.

emily: QA run complete — smoke ok, throughput within expected variance. Attaching quick findings: 3 minor output diffs in eval set B (non-blocking).

jordan: Thanks — I'll keep an eye on quant drift logs.

release-captain: Action checklist (TL;DR):
1) Docs embargo: lock at 09:30 UTC Fri — all merges blocked except approved exceptions. @mike holds key.
2) Canary window shortened to 30m with tighter alerting thresholds (see above).
3) SRE to increase trace retention + enable slow-path logs — @sasha.
4) QA runs at 08:00 UTC Fri — @emily post summary here.
5) Any exception -> PR + label `release/docs-exception` + approvals.

Please react with :thumbsup: when you have actioned your items so we can close this thread before the freeze.
